input.summary:
B third floor lit: min light 8, 0 dark, 0 dim (was min 7, 2 dim at x=12 by the stair well); make.sh builds the whole build.nbt, room 58 placed, 0 refused.
Designer's premise was wrong: no block at y=22 above the four hanging lanterns (ceiling is the roof-deck slab at y=23), so they hung from air. Added iron_chain (axis y) at y=22 from the slab to each lantern at (13,21,14), (17,21,14), (15,21,19), (17,21,22); plus a hanging lantern at (12,22,20) under the slab (lifts the dim cells). mcd check now reports 0 floating blocks.
Standing lantern (15,20,15) passes mcd check on the desk slab (15,19,15), but that is a bottom slab, so its top is at y=19.5 and the lantern floats half a block. Air-only edits; no furniture moved.

waste.what: Worked out which cells sat above each lantern and under the ceiling by querying blocks one cell at a time with a throwaway node script
waste.cost: about 35 single-cell lookups, 3 rounds, to find that y=22 is air and the ceiling is y=23
waste.tool: mcd room or mcd check should print the ceiling y above each lantern (or the first solid block above) and flag 'nothing within 1 block above' per lantern, plus a per-cell block query (mcd at x,y,z)

waste.what: Chose chain-versus-lantern placement by hand from the 'nothing above' check, and had to re-run make.sh to test each guess
waste.tool: mcd room --suggest-hang could list the chain length needed to reach the nearest solid block above each unsupported lantern

waste.what: mcd walk listed 12 y=21 cells as unreached (bookcase shelf tops) with no explanation in the room report
waste.cost: a reading pass to confirm the lighting was not the cause
waste.tool: mcd walk could say which floor cells are on top of furniture (standable only from above) instead of listing them as unreached

companions.task: Decide whether the desk-top slab at (14..15,19,15) should be a top slab so the standing lantern at (15,20,15) sits flush on it, and confirm the bookcase shelf tops at y=20 are meant to be standable only from above.
Back the attic ladders at (4,19..20,23) and (26,19..20,23): the wall they hang from ends at y=17, so there is nothing behind them at y=19..20 (mcd check reports UNSUPPORTED).

left: Standing lantern (15,20,15) on the desk slab (15,19,15): mcd check passes it, but the bottom slab's top is at y=19.5, so the lantern floats about half a block. Fix is the designer's (top-type slab for the desk top); I did not move or replace the furniture.
Attic ladders (4,19..20,23) and (26,19..20,23) are UNSUPPORTED per mcd check: behind them at x=3 and x=27 the wall ends at y=17. Stairs part, not this room.
The designer's note said the ceiling is at y=22. It is y=23 (roof-deck slab). The chains at y=22 bridge the gap; the designer's rooms.json and plan wording should be corrected to match.
